name: KernelCraft
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y nasm gcc-multilib binutils qemu-system-x86 && npm install && npm run setup:linux

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional: enables AI OS builds with Claude. Without it the app runs in offline template mode.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional: enables AI OS builds with Groq (used when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set).
